n.story:
Your role remains a bastion of physical skill and situational awareness, largely shielded from the total automation seen in office-based jobs. While the core of your work—the physical act of cleaning glass in unpredictable outdoor environments—remains manual, AI will become a silent partner in your safety and business management. The tedious 'office work' of your job, such as filing activity reports, managing supply inventories, and tracking invoices, will largely vanish into automated, voice-controlled systems.

On the job site, your expertise is amplified by AI-driven risk assessment tools. Before you even clip into a harness, computer vision tools can scan a building's facade to identify structural risks or window damage that the naked eye might miss. You will transition from being a manual laborer to a tech-enabled technician who uses data to ensure maximum safety and efficiency, spending less time on paperwork and more time on high-quality service delivery.

n.adv: Embrace mobile-first AI tools for reporting and damage assessment to increase your professional value to property managers. Your physical dexterity is your greatest asset; protect it by using AI to enhance your safety protocols.
